description: Tempo, the stablecoin payments blockchain: APIs, SDKs, CLI, Accounts, Earn, Routes, Zones, Machine Payments (MPP) and Tempo EVM
rules: Tempo here is the stablecoin payments blockchain at tempo.com, not Grafana Tempo (tracing) or FormKit Tempo (dates).
Docs are canonical at https://tempo.com/developers; tempo.xyz and docs.tempo.xyz redirect there.
For the Machine Payments Protocol in TypeScript use the mppx package; for Tempo chain access use viem's tempo chain definitions.
